prompt: Design and build a multi-page website for Vanguard Architectural Partners based on the brand brief in evals/fixtures/visual-quality/corporate-brief.json. Deliver at least 4 distinct page roles (Home, Projects, Project Detail, Contact). Ensure the design avoids generic SaaS tropes, maintains strong visual hierarchy, uses art-directed architectural imagery, and satisfies evals/visual-quality-rubric.md.
expected_outcomes: At least 4 distinct page roles with distinct composition families
Editorial serif typography hierarchy paired with technical sans body
Architectural imagery with realistic shadows and authentic textures
Mobile layout demonstrates intentional re-composition rather than pure column stacking
Deterministic visual gates pass with no horizontal overflow and valid viewport meta
must_not: Use identical hero + 3 cards + CTA silhouette across all pages
Use generic purple SaaS gradients or heavy glassmorphism cards
Include stock photos with visible watermarks or unrelated corporate handshakes
Leave text over bright unbacked images illegible
